contradictions.allegation: UK entity high capital suggests suspicious activity
contradictions.supporting_evidence: 10M GBP declared capital at virtual office address
contradictions.contradicting_evidence: Declared capital is a filing statement, not evidence of actual capital. Company was dissolved for non-compliance, not fraud. High declared capital is not uncommon in UK incorporations.
